accountability_scope: Approve AIMS scope, policy, objectives, resources, management review, material risk acceptance and certification decisions.
mandatory_competencies: AIMS governance; risk-based decision making; evidence-state discipline; authority boundaries; resource allocation
prohibited_conflicts: May not treat delegated VE output as human accountability; should not represent self-assessment as independent certification
evidence_required: Management assignment decision; relevant experience/training/competence record; management-review participation evidence
review_trigger: Material scope/authority change; certification planning; annual or management-defined competence review

accountability_scope: Own intended use, lifecycle, system inventory, change impact, operational limits and system-level risk inputs.
mandatory_competencies: System architecture; lifecycle management; intended-use definition; change impact; reliability/security awareness
prohibited_conflicts: Should not independently approve own high/critical residual risk without AIMS/risk authority
evidence_required: Named assignment; role-relevant experience/training; system ownership evidence; reviewed intended-use/risk records
review_trigger: New material system; owner change; consequential deployment; major architecture/provider change

accountability_scope: Assess, treat, monitor and escalate assigned AI risks and residual risk.
mandatory_competencies: Risk identification; impact analysis; treatment selection; evidence evaluation; escalation discipline
prohibited_conflicts: May not silently accept high/critical risk; material acceptance remains with authorized human management
evidence_required: Named assignment; risk-method competence; completed/reviewed risk assessments; treatment follow-up evidence
review_trigger: New high/critical risk; treatment failure; incident; system/supplier change; owner change

accountability_scope: Implement, maintain and evidence assigned technical or organizational controls.
mandatory_competencies: Control objective understanding; implementation discipline; verification evidence; change management
prohibited_conflicts: Should not be sole independent assessor of own material control where independent review is required
evidence_required: Named assignment; control-specific competence; implementation evidence; corrective-action history where applicable
review_trigger: Control change; failed verification; finding/nonconformity; owner change

accountability_scope: Own security/reliability controls, incident containment support, least privilege and operational resilience.
mandatory_competencies: Application/cloud/database security; reliability; incident response; secrets/access controls; recovery concepts
prohibited_conflicts: Privilege changes and destructive production actions require authorized scope; may not self-approve critical exceptions
evidence_required: Named assignment; role-relevant technical evidence/training; incident/security review evidence; access/authority record
review_trigger: Security architecture change; production activation; incident; privileged-access change

accountability_scope: Own data classification, acquisition authority, provenance, quality, access, retention and privacy-impact inputs.
mandatory_competencies: Data governance; privacy principles; provenance/lineage; quality; retention/disposition; sensitive-data handling
prohibited_conflicts: May not infer lawful basis or retention periods without applicable legal/contract review
evidence_required: Named assignment; data/privacy competence evidence; reviewed data-flow/classification/retention records
review_trigger: New data class/source; memory/RAG ingestion; jurisdiction/customer change; retention/access change

accountability_scope: Verify technical evidence and conduct sufficiently independent AIMS review/audit work.
mandatory_competencies: Test/evidence evaluation; audit methods; sampling; independence; finding documentation; corrective-action effectiveness review
prohibited_conflicts: Should not audit own work where practical; cannot certify CoMind or close own unsupported findings
evidence_required: Named reviewer/auditor; competence evidence; independence/conflict check; review/audit records
review_trigger: Internal-audit scheduling; material finding; certification planning; reviewer/conflict change

accountability_scope: Classify incidents, coordinate containment/escalation, preserve evidence, assign communications and drive corrective action.
mandatory_competencies: Incident command; severity assessment; evidence preservation; stakeholder communication; recovery/corrective-action coordination
prohibited_conflicts: May not suppress required escalation or invent external notification obligations/deadlines
evidence_required: Named incident authority/on-call route; incident-response competence; exercises/incidents; communication approvals
review_trigger: Incident; exercise; service/product scope change; regulatory/customer applicability change

accountability_scope: Assess material AI/cloud/development suppliers, data flows, terms, continuity, cost dependency and exit/reassessment triggers.
mandatory_competencies: Supplier risk; service/data-flow understanding; contract/terms review coordination; continuity/exit planning; cost/lock-in analysis
prohibited_conflicts: May not infer supplier certification, contractual protection or data-processing terms without evidence
evidence_required: Named assignment; supplier-review competence; completed supplier assessments; reassessment/exit evidence
review_trigger: New supplier; material terms/subprocessor/region/model/service change; outage/incident; cost or exit trigger
